sprint: Family Photos — shared Google Photos albums in Studio (Phases 1-3). A parent shares one or more PUBLIC Google Photos albums; the kid browses and picks photos from them alongside the ordinary local picker (never replacing it). Server side: the family-album Edge Function (supabase/functions/family-album/) scrapes a public shared-album page's inline photo list (AF_initDataCallback + JSON5 loose-parse, ported from the daily-CI-proven yumetodo extraction) and doubles as a host-validated image byte proxy — the owner's live go/no-go test verdict was GO (proxy): browsing thumbnails load direct from lh3 for free, only an actual pick routes one proxied image through Supabase. Storage: new family_albums table (multiple albums per kid, label + sort_order, fully modifiable, owner-scoped RLS with a Magic Card recall read grant). Client: js/familyAlbum.js (album CRUD via ThemeRepositoryClient's own session, ~1h localStorage photo-list cache with stale-cache fallback, proxied pick to a data URL feeding the exact same Picture Studio -> AssetStore pipeline a local file pick uses). Studio UI (js/contextPanel.js): a Family Photos row in Add Something (lands as a freestanding image sticker) and a From Family Album button on the Artwork panel (fills the selected Place) — both open one shared picker with album chips, a lazy thumbnail grid, and honest unreachable/empty states; a parent-facing Manage Albums panel (add/rename/replace link/remove) sits behind it. Creator-only by product decision: a Traveller who taps in sees a companion-framed nudge toward their first Publish instead of the picker.
task: Also fixes a real, systemic latent RLS bug found while validating the new policy against a real local Postgres 16: a policy USING subquery runs under the querying user's own RLS on the tables it references, so every shipped cross-owner grant (themes_personal_select redeemer clause, theme_assets_personal_read, creator_projects_select recall clause, draft_assets_owner_read) joined through an owner-only-SELECT table (cards / magic_card_identities) and silently returned zero rows for any genuinely cross-owner session — never surfaced live because Builder+Studio share one origin/anonymous session, so every live redemption so far was self-redemption. Fixed with two SECURITY DEFINER proof-check helpers (has_card_redemption_grant, has_magic_recall_grant); all five policies now call them. Verified: full schema applies clean + idempotent on local Postgres 16, three-uid functional RLS proof (recaller sees albums/projects, redeemer sees the redeemed theme — all three were 0 pre-fix; strangers/writes still blocked); parse.js 14/14 in Node; js/familyAlbum.js 32/32 via a mocked-Supabase Playwright suite. supabase/schema.sql must be re-run in the Supabase SQL editor (idempotent).
